Metadata.title: Persona — API documentation
Metadata.description: Explore Persona, the public API for coherent fictional people.

Home.eyebrow: Synthetic people for a brighter product world
Home.title: Fictional people for products and tests.
Home.description: Generate coherent fictional profiles with a name, age, location, contact details and, when available, a reviewed portrait. Reproduce results with a seed.
Home.note: Open beta · No API key required
Home.portraitAlt: Reviewed portrait of the fictional profile Christian Arnaud
Home.keylessDescription: GET /people returns structured JSON without signup or an API key.
Home.seedDescription: Supply a seed and reference date to replay a result with the same data and catalog versions.
Home.coverageDescription: 209 of 249 recognized country and territory codes can generate profiles in the current beta.
Home.closingTitle: From your first request to a convincing test profile.
Home.closingDescription: The current catalog includes 1,764 approved portraits. A profile can still return no image when none matches; generated addresses and contact details are for examples, not delivery or outreach.
